panels.title: App Container RSS Memory by Pod
App Container Working Set by Pod
Container CPU by Service

targets.expr:
sum by(service) (
  label_replace(sum by(pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor",namespace="perf-lab",pod=~"app-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[1m])), "service", "spring", "pod", ".*")
  or
  label_replace(sum by(pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor",namespace="perf-lab",pod=~"postgres-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[1m])), "service", "postgres", "pod", ".*")
  or
  label_replace(sum by(pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor",namespace="perf-lab",pod=~"redis-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[1m])), "service", "redis", "pod", ".*")
  or
  label_replace(sum by(pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor",namespace="perf-lab",pod=~"prometheus-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[1m])), "service", "prometheus", "pod", ".*")
  or
  label_replace(sum by(pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor",namespace="perf-lab",pod=~"grafana-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[1m])), "service", "grafana", "pod", ".*")
  or
  label_replace(sum by(pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor",namespace="perf-lab",pod=~"postgres-exporter-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[1m])), "service", "postgres-exporter", "pod", ".*")
  or
  label_replace(sum by(pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor",namespace="perf-lab",pod=~"redis-exporter-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[1m])), "service", "redis-exporter", "pod", ".*")
  or
  label_replace(sum by(pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor",namespace="perf-lab",pod=~"cadvisor-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[1m])), "service", "cadvisor", "pod", ".*")
  or
  label_replace(sum by(pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor",namespace="perf-lab",pod=~"node-exporter-.*",container!="",container!="POD"}[1m])), "service", "node-exporter", "pod", ".*")
) * 100
